children: Theravance Bi announced supplemental disclosures to its proxy and confirmed three shareholder complaints tied to the proposed merger with Zymeworks.
Filed definitive proxy for shareholder vote on Sept. 18, 2026 to approve merger with Zymeworks and related transactions.
Three complaints seek to enjoin the merger or rescind it and allege disclosure omissions; 13 additional demand letters received.
Company denies claims but voluntarily supplemented proxy to minimize litigation burden and avoid delay or disruption to the merger.
Supplement adds detailed outreach, bidding and diligence history, Evercore $7M closing fee and Lazard valuation inputs ($15.25–$16.25/share implied).

title: Theravance Bi in merger with Zymeworks faces shareholder suits, supplements proxy with disclosures
